low.name: 20-Year Level Term Life
low.description: Fixed-premium term life policy providing guaranteed death benefit for 20 years. Ideal for income replacement and mortgage protection.

low.name: Standard Homeowners (HO-3)
low.description: Broad open-perils homeowners policy covering dwelling, personal property, and liability. Most widely issued residential coverage form.

low.name: Personal Auto Liability
low.description: State-mandated liability coverage with bodily injury and property damage limits, plus optional collision and comprehensive.

low.name: Group Health — PPO Plan
low.description: Employer-sponsored preferred provider organization plan with broad network access, preventive care, and prescription drug benefits.

low.name: Short-Term Disability Income
low.description: Replaces up to 60% of pre-disability income for covered illness or injury for benefit periods of 13–26 weeks.

medium.name: Whole Life Insurance
medium.description: Permanent life coverage with guaranteed death benefit, level premiums, and cash value accumulation at a declared dividend rate.

medium.name: Business Owners Policy (BOP)
medium.description: Bundled commercial package combining property, general liability, and business interruption coverage for small-to-mid businesses.

medium.name: Personal Umbrella Liability
medium.description: Excess liability coverage providing $1M–$5M above underlying auto and homeowners policies for catastrophic claims.

medium.name: Long-Term Disability Income
medium.description: Own-occupation disability coverage replacing 60–70% of income to age 65, with cost-of-living adjustment riders available.

medium.name: Commercial General Liability (CGL)
medium.description: Broad commercial liability coverage for bodily injury, property damage, and personal and advertising injury exposures.

high.name: Variable Universal Life (VUL)
high.description: Flexible-premium permanent life with investment sub-accounts. Death benefit and cash value fluctuate with market performance.

high.name: Professional Indemnity (E&O)
high.description: Errors and omissions coverage for professionals against claims of negligence, malpractice, or inadequate service.

high.name: Directors & Officers (D&O)
high.description: Protects corporate officers and directors against personal liability from managerial decisions and securities litigation.

high.name: Cyber Liability Insurance
high.description: First- and third-party coverage for data breaches, ransomware, business interruption, and regulatory fines from cyber events.

high.name: Commercial Marine & Cargo
high.description: Ocean and inland marine coverage for goods in transit, warehouse legal liability, and hull and machinery for vessels.

high.name: Construction All-Risk (CAR)
high.description: Project-specific property and third-party liability coverage for construction projects from groundbreaking to completion.

high.name: Kidnap, Ransom & Extortion
high.description: Coverage for ransom payments, extortion demands, and related crisis response costs for executives operating in high-risk regions.

high.name: Aviation Liability
high.description: Liability and hull coverage for private and commercial aircraft operators, including passenger liability and ground-handling exposures.
